_doc: GD-26 C-06 band file (02 s18.3, R0 B.25 A-128). The 02 band is band.one_flak_survive_min 60 (% of Bombers that release with one Flak) and band.two_flak_die_min 80 (% that die before release with two). one_flak_survive_min / two_flak_die_min are the regression floors the test enforces: the 02 band for a half that is met (two Flak: measured 98 %), else the measured rate minus 10 points, floored at 0 (A-128; one Flak: measured 0 %), with the measured rates in `measured`. 'band open: GD-34' = the 02 band is missed under valid preconditions; GD-34 retunes the anchors by data and restores the floors to the band. Lives in test/sim/balance/, not test/sim/scenarios/: tools/schemas/sim_scenario.schema.json (additionalProperties false, the TA-33 runner) cannot hold these keys. bomber_rel_m overrides the brain's three attack_run band heights (deck_alt_agl_m, band_low_agl_m, band_high_agl_m) for the C-06 legs (A-139); the shipped bands are the control leg C-06c, pinned under measured.shipped_bands (A-138: the Deck dive under a known Flak is counterplay, 850-940 m is the Deck horizon of 02 s10.3).
